chapters.name: P1 X14 / Target-aware crop and capabilities

items.label: Home composition
items.meaning: Per-target framing saves independently

items.label: Lock composition
items.meaning: Clock and lock overlays can obscure important content

items.label: Separate target previews
items.meaning: Identical source permits independent crop settings

items.label: Lock unsupported
items.meaning: Unsupported target must not imply OS success

items.label: Apply both
items.meaning: Report per-target results, including partial acknowledgments

chapters.name: P1 X15 / Large library operations

items.label: Large library
items.meaning: Dense library controls must remain responsive and readable

items.label: Filter results
items.meaning: Filtered count and original collection count stay distinct

items.label: Select a group
items.meaning: Batch identity and scope clear before mutation

items.label: Exclude confirmation
items.meaning: No destructive delete implied by exclude

items.label: Restore eligibility
items.meaning: Restore reshapes shuffle eligibility without duplicates

chapters.name: P1 X16 / Rule conflict and simulation

items.label: Two enabled rules
items.meaning: Both rules individually valid

items.label: Conflict at 20:00
items.meaning: Explicit collision, not silent resolution

items.label: Evening rule wins
items.meaning: English explanation and reversible change

items.label: Nested conditions
items.meaning: Logical grouping remains visually explicit

items.label: Schedule simulation
items.meaning: Simulation cannot apply wallpaper

chapters.name: P1 X17 / Source rights and network consequences

items.label: Discover sources
items.meaning: Provider identity and network status visible

items.label: Provider details
items.meaning: Provider-specific information, not directory repeated

items.label: Image rights
items.meaning: Rights and attribution are image-specific, not provider-wide

items.label: Source offline
items.meaning: Local offline assets remain available

items.label: Source import incomplete
items.meaning: Preserve verified copies; retries are scoped

chapters.name: P1 X18 / History, diagnosis and reapply

items.label: Activity history
items.meaning: Requested, attempted and confirmed are distinct events

items.label: Unconfirmed outcome
items.meaning: Do not infer successful apply from interrupted process

items.label: Delayed eligibility
items.meaning: Active-use schedule is not exact background alarm

items.label: Retry action
items.meaning: A duplicate system effect is possible; warn before retry

items.label: Previous wallpaper
items.meaning: Reapply creates a new operation, not retroactive success

chapters.name: P1 X19 / Backup and restore integrity

items.label: Export scope
items.meaning: Photo bytes excluded unless explicitly chosen

items.label: Review exported content
items.meaning: Exact scope visible before file is produced

items.label: Restore preview
items.meaning: Preview missing providers and ID collisions

items.label: Resolve conflict
items.meaning: Keep existing user data until chosen

items.label: Restore completed
items.meaning: Outcome and exclusions auditable

chapters.name: P1 X20 / External Android-hosted controls

items.label: Home screen widget
items.meaning: This is launcher UI, not an in-app imitation

items.label: Resize widget
items.meaning: Text and target remain legible at launcher sizes

items.label: Quick Settings tile
items.meaning: No fake status from in-app preview

items.label: App shortcut
items.meaning: Shortcut target is explicit before wallpaper effect

items.label: Unavailable OS integration
items.meaning: Graceful unavailability, no fake install success

chapters.name: P1 X21 / Settings, help and return

items.label: Home overflow
items.meaning: Support navigation preserves browsing context

items.label: Help and About
items.meaning: No fifth top-level tab or decorative second reel

items.label: Capabilities help
items.meaning: Platform restriction explained without impossible permission

items.label: Report a problem
items.meaning: No automatic upload of private data

items.label: Return to Home
items.meaning: Back restores selection, scroll and rotation status

chapters.name: P1 X22 / Exact diagnostic report handoff

items.label: Describe the problem
items.meaning: Report is local draft, never auto uploaded

items.label: Review exact outgoing fields
items.meaning: Exclude image bytes, tokens and private paths

items.label: Choose report scope
items.meaning: Consent granular and reversible

items.label: Choose copy, local save or Android Sharesheet
items.meaning: Outgoing payload is a sample, native implementation must show exact bytes; chooser is not successful delivery

items.label: No supported handler
items.meaning: Retain draft after cancelled/unavailable share

chapters.name: P1 X23 / Adverse asynchronous input states

items.label: Loading imported photo
items.meaning: Loading not disguised as empty collection

items.label: Cloud item pending
items.meaning: Do not show imported until durable copy verified

items.label: Long filenames and names
items.meaning: Ellipsis or multiline must not hide action or count

items.label: Duplicate labels
items.meaning: Names may repeat; identities must not be guessed

items.label: Batch partial failure
items.meaning: No premature all-done badge or lost successful copies
